lines.text: At evening Jesus tells His disciples to cross to the other side, and they take Him in the boat.
A violent windstorm comes up, and the waves break over the boat until it is being swamped.
Jesus is sleeping on the cushion in the bow, and the disciples wake Him and call Him Teacher.
Jesus rebukes the rain and the sea, and the storm dies down and it is perfectly calm.
Jesus asks why they are so afraid, and they ask who this is that the wind and sea obey.
